name: com.vklubkov.transportoversteamworks
displayName: Transport Over Steamworks for Unity Netcode
description: Network Transport for Unity Netcode (a.k.a. "Netcode for Entities") implemented using Steamworks SDK (ISteamNetworkingSockets). - Created specifically for use with Unity Netcode. - Tested with Steamworks.NET. - Supports P2P, Fake IP, and real IP connections. Servers/hosts can have all three types of listen sockets at the same time. - Conversion between Steamworks messages <-> Unity Transport packets is done via bursted jobs. This package only handles the data transfer over Steamworks. It doesn't initialize Steamworks, doesn't initialize Unity Netcode, doesn't handle matchmaking, doesn't initiate connections, doesn't start sockets etc. It also doesn't bundle Steamworks.NET or the Steamworks SDK DLL.
